output.question: Who is the founder of Five Guys?
output.answer: Jerry Murrell and his wife Janie Murrell founded Five Guys in 1986. The first restaurant was a carry-out burger shop in Arlington, Virginia. Five Guys' own website calls Jerry Murrell 'Five Guys founder' and says the business began when Jerry and Janie told their sons to either start a business or go to college. The name first referred to Jerry and his four oldest sons. After Tyler was born in 1987, it came to mean the five Murrell sons, who all work in the business.

key_facts.fact: Five Guys was founded in 1986 by Janie and Jerry Murrell.
Five Guys' official site calls Jerry Murrell 'Five Guys founder'.
The first location opened in 1986 in Arlington, Virginia, in the Westmont Shopping Center.
All five Murrell sons (Jim, Matt, Chad, Ben, Tyler) are involved in the business.

caveats: Sources differ on credit. Five Guys' own site names Jerry as 'founder', while Wikipedia credits both Jerry and Janie. The Murrell sons are often described as co-founders or the 'five guys'.
Jerry Murrell's formal name appears to be Victor Jerome Murrell. This comes from a search-result snippet on a Marketscreener insider listing, which was not opened.
The current CEO and executive titles were not verified. Wikipedia lists key people without giving titles.
